title: Jim Penniston told the beings come from 8,000 years in the future (Rendlesham)

tellings.quote: specifically told Jim penniston they said we are you uh we come from 8,000 years in the future and yeah that they're having problems with reproduction and they're taking these gtes

plain: In 1980, during an encounter in Rendlesham Forest in England, a witness named Jim Penniston is said to have been told by the beings: "we are you," come from 8,000 years in the future. They are said to have told him they were having trouble reproducing, and that this is why they were taking reproductive cells. A researcher named Mike Masters retells this to Michels without naming a source. If true, it would mean the visitors are our own descendants.
